name: Village of West Haverstraw Summer Day Camp
activities: pool time at Bowline Point Park
description_short: Village day camp open only to West Haverstraw residents, running 9 am to 4 pm with swim lessons and pool time at Bowline Point Park built into each week and two paid trips most weeks, such as bowling, mini golf and a water park. Lunch is provided on camp days.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons and pool time at Bowline Point Park are part of the weekly schedule; campers bring a swimsuit and towel.

fees.name: Week 1 trips (Breakpoint Bowling $30, movies $10)
fees.note: Trips are not included in the weekly fee; the page doesn't say whether a camper can skip them

notes: Residents only: registration at Village Hall needs two proofs of West Haverstraw residency. $50 a week per child ($40 for the short first week); second sibling 50% off registration, third sibling free. Early drop off from 8 am and pick up until 5 pm. A card fee applies to credit or debit payments (amount not posted). Weekly registration deadlines from June 12. Registration was closed when checked.
